dog.description_text:
Meet Orion! This boy deserves a universe of love, and we're on a mission to find him his perfect home. Rescued from a heartbreaking hoarding situation in Georgia, Orion is ready for a fresh start and the chance to discover just how wonderful life can be with a family of his own. Think cozy nights, new adventures, and someone who will always make room for him. His forever family is out there somewhere. Could you be the star he's been waiting for?

Every bio is just a snapshot of the animal. For more information about Orion and to learn if he may be the right fit for your home, please reach out to our Adoptions Team.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
